summary: Entra Policy Suite 2.1 gathers recent improvements; nothing breaks and there is nothing to do.

new.title: Entra Policy Suite 2.1 installs by itself
new.text: Your installation moves from 2.0 to 2.1 on its own, on its usual update ring. Nothing breaks and there is nothing for you to do.

new.title: Runs on Microsoft's current supported platform
new.text: The whole product now runs on .NET 10 and PowerShell 7.6, both supported by Microsoft until November 2028.

new.title: Hanging jobs are restarted automatically
new.text: A job that hangs is caught, stopped and started once more, and Invardia support is told at once.

new.title: Fewer false alarms from the support link
new.text: One report to Invardia that could not be delivered no longer turns the Invardia support link amber, and you are never mailed about it.
